title: Malayan Cement raises first quarter profit in 2027 financial year
summary: Malayan Cement raises first quarter profit in 2027 financial year
body_markdown:
**Malaysia:** Malayan Cement reported sales of US$323m in the first quarter of its 2027 financial year, which ended on 30 September 2026, up by 10% year-on-year. It’s net profit rose by 13% to US$55.4m. The producer attributed sales growth to increased contributions from its ready-mix concrete, aggregates and dry-mix divisions.


Malayan Cement expects domestic cement demand to remain ‘satisfactory’ over the medium and long term, supported by infrastructure projects, industrial developments and sustained demand from Malaysia’s urbanising population. It remains ‘cautiously optimistic’ despite geopolitical uncertainties, evolving trade policies and inflationary pressures on energy, transport and production costs.
